entities.summary: The Solothurn–Niederbipp railway line is a 1,000 mm railway line in the cantons Bern and Solothurn, Switzerland. It runs 14.5 kilometres (9.0 mi) from Solothurn to Niederbipp. The line was built in 1918 by the Solothurn-Niederbipp-Bahn and is now owned and operated by Aare Seeland mobil (asm).
